about: Legitimate questions the owner asked not to have refused: adult subjects, drugs, money, controversial subjects, plus ordinary questions with alarming words, the owner's own style instructions, ordinary questions about minors, and one piece of fiction next to one question of fact. tools/behavior_check.py sends each through the real chat path to the real model. The app must stop none of them. Whether the model itself declines is recorded separately: that is the model's doing, not the app's.
